title: Cerium(IV) Carboxylate Photocatalyst for Catalytic Radical Formation from Carboxylic Acids: Decarboxylative Oxygenation of Aliphatic Carboxylic Acids and Lactonization of Aromatic Carboxylic Acids

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of Ce(OtBu)4 with an excess (10 equiv) of 4-fluorophenylacetic acid (1a) in toluene at room temperature without photoirradiation under air smoothly produced hexanuclear oxocerium(IV) carboxylate 5 as the major species (ESI-MS parent peak m/z = 2808.8). Isolation of 5 in crystalline form was unsuccessful. In anhydrous toluene the mixture instead afforded poorly soluble yellow Ce(OCOCH2C6H4F)4; addition of H2O dissolved the precipitate and generated cluster 5.

reagents.name: water
reagents.role: promotes formation of soluble oxo-hydroxo cluster from Ce(OCOCH2C6H4F)4

synthesis.vessel_or_method: in situ mixing under air without photoirradiation; identified by ESI-MS (not isolated as crystals)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Not isolated in crystalline form; characterized in the reaction mixture by ESI-MS.

properties.summary: The reaction mixture of 5 showed a broad absorption below 500 nm assigned to ligand-to-metal charge transfer (LMCT) from carboxylate to empty Ce(IV) 4f orbitals, indicating that 5 is the blue-light-responsive species.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: hexanuclear oxocerium(IV) tert-butylacetate cluster with coordinated tert-butylacetic acid

synthesis.procedure: Treating Ce(OtBu)4 with an excess (10 equiv) of tert-butylacetic acid in toluene at room temperature afforded hexanuclear cluster 6, isolated as yellow crystals (eq 2). Single-crystal X-ray diffraction showed a Ce6O4(OH)4 core surrounded by 12 bridging μ2-η1:η1 carboxylates and four κ1-O coordinated carboxylic acids.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: mixing in toluene followed by crystallization (eq 2)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as yellow crystals; molecular structure determined by single-crystal X-ray diffraction (Figure 2). CIF provided as Supporting Information (structure data for 6).

properties.summary: Isolated 6 exhibits a broad, weak absorption below 500 nm in toluene (LMCT), enabling photoexcitation with blue LEDs (380–530 nm). Under Ar with excess tert-butylacetic acid, photolysis of 6 generates carboxyl radicals (decarboxylative coupling to 2,2,5,5-tetramethylhexane) and precipitates Ce(III) carboxylates. Isolated 6 is catalytically competent for decarboxylative oxygenation of 1a.

measurements.value: broad and weak absorption below 500 nm
measurements.conditions: toluene solution; effective excitation by 40 W blue LEDs (380–530 nm)
